definitions.explanation: A feeling of unhappiness or displeasure about something; grumbling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{待遇|たいぐう}→待遇：12517_taiguu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不平|ふへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
{不平|ふへい}⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たずに→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: To work without complaints or dissatisfaction.
examples.notes: 不平不満 = complaints and dissatisfaction

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不平|ふへい}⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦{聞|き}かされる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I keep having to listen to his complaints.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{不平|ふへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many employees grumble that the pay is low.
examples.notes: 不平を漏らす = to grumble, to let complaints slip

examples.japanese: {不平|ふへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えよう→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Complaining won't change anything, so let's think about what we can do ourselves.

notes:
USAGE: {不平|ふへい} often appears with ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧ in the set phrase {不平|ふへい}⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {不平|ふへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to complain)
- {不平|ふへい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧ (to grumble)
- {不平|ふへい}⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧ (complaints and dissatisfaction)
- {不平|ふへい}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧ (without complaint)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧ - dissatisfaction (internal feeling)
- ⟦{苦情|くじょう}→苦情：00252_kujou⟧ - complaint (formal, to authority)
- ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧ - complaint (casual, verbal)
